title: PlagueHO/foundry-agentic-workshop
summary: 该实验性实验室通过Azure AI Foundry提供端到端的环境配置脚本，帮助工程师从L200级别提升至L300级别，构建基于Azure的智能代理解决方案。包括基于提示的代理、多代理工具、Python中的Microsoft Agent Framework以及Foundry IQ知识检索。涉及模型训练、推理、架构设计和性能优化等技术。
description: A hands-on lab that takes engineers from L200 to L300 building agentic solutions on Azure AI Foundry — hosted and prompt-based agents, multi-agent tools, the Microsoft Agent Framework in Python, and Foundry IQ knowledge retrieval — with scripts to provision the shared lab environment end-to-end.
